\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Profile}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Profile
\section{Overview}
The Gaussian quantile and isoperimetric profile satisfy inverse-function derivative identities, reflection laws, and convexity estimates. The profile extended by zero is continuous, including at the endpoint probabilities.

\end{lemma}
